create_impala_agent: create an IMPALA agent instance with JAX backend for OpenSpiel game environments
build_basic_rnn_network: build a BasicRNN recurrent neural network core with LSTM and linear heads for policy, value, and prediction outputs
run_policy_gradient_training: run policy gradient training with VTrace importance-sampled actor-critic loss on collected trajectories
compute_vtrace_loss: compute VTrace-based actor-critic loss including policy gradient, baseline, entropy, and prediction losses
update_agent_parameters: update agent parameters via RMSProp optimizer using JAX autodiff gradients from the loss function
